Industrial/metal demand firm: CPER (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND; gold rangebound: GLD (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION, silver SLV (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -2.28%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +12.76%) CORRECTION with large 1M gains but near-term pullback; oil ETFs like BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: +25.08%) CORRECTION show short-term retracement within strong monthly moves; natural gas UNG (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -12.67%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND show durable cyclical leadership; DIVERGENCE: multiple commodity and thematic ETFs (e.g., BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) CORRECTION, IBIT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.82%) CORRECTION) exhibit 1W/1M mismatches that warrant caution.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclical exposure given XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND and XLY (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging tech XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND and defensive utilities XLU (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND while monitoring bond downside in TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND.

BEARISH: XLU (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND, XBI (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND, SOXX (1W: -4.20% | 1M: -15.81%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**

BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -12.67%) BELOW TREND, TAN (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -14.65%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, showing broad but not overwhelming strength. XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) and XLY (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%) showing relative strength while XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) shows weakness — monitor commodity and thematic 1W/1M divergences (e.g., BNO, IBIT).
